reason: The first expected target was Store although the request required Save Changes. The old checker did not enforce the frozen candidate identity. Token counts used joint prompt+target encoding. This report does not establish a valid contract.

originalReport.targetRule: Complete edited file text only, followed by EOS; no wrapper or explanation.

scoring.exactMatch: UTF-8 text equality after CRLF/CR to LF normalization; preserve all other whitespace.
scoring.preservation: Compare actual and expected replacement spans; all text outside the single expected span must match input.
scoring.unnecessaryEdits: Count output changes outside the expected replacement; exact-match success has zero.
scoring.syntaxCheckability: Record per-language syntax check status when a later evaluator provides a cheap checker; exact fixture targets are known-valid.
